expected.summary: The March 31, 2022 bidder conference date was replaced.
expected.evidence: Pre-Bid Conference changed from "Thursday, March 31, 2022; 1:00- 2:00 PM.

expected.summary: The bidder conference was moved to April 5, 2022 from 1:00 to 2:00 PM.
expected.evidence: to "Tuesday, April 5, 2022; 1:00 - 2:00 PM (updated from 3/31/22 date).

expected.summary: Attendance was strongly suggested rather than mandatory.
expected.evidence: Attendance is strongly suggested.

expected.summary: Written questions were due through COMMBUYS on April 7, 2022 at 2:00 PM EST.
expected.evidence: Deadline for submission of written questions through COMMBUYS “Bid Q&A” April 7, 2022, 2:00 PM EST

expected.summary: The bid opening deadline was May 3, 2022 at 3:00 PM.
Responses had to be sent through COMMBUYS Create Quote.
expected.evidence: Responses must be sent via the “Create Quote” functionality contained in COMMBUYS.

expected.summary: The quote had to be signed electronically through acceptance on the Terms & Conditions tab.
expected.evidence: Quotes submitted via COMMBUYS must be signed electronically by the Bidder or the Bidder’s Agent by accepting the terms and conditions of the bid on the “Terms & Conditions” tab of the Bid in COMMBUYS.

expected.summary: Narrative responses should not exceed ten double-sided pages, excluding forms and attachments.
expected.evidence: Bidders should submit no more than ten (10) double-sided pages (excluding the required forms and attachments) of narrative

expected.summary: Provided forms had to remain in their original formats and not be converted to PDF.
expected.evidence: must be completed, and submitted in their original formats, NOT scanned and submitted as PDF or other file types.

expected.summary: Security Services bidders needed at least three years in that business.
expected.evidence: Bidders must have been in the business of providing Security Services for a minimum of three (3) years

expected.summary: Category 1 bidders had to attach a PDF of a current Watch Guard Manager License or Massachusetts Certification Unit certification.
expected.evidence: Bidders for Security Services must include a pdf attachment of their current Watch Guard Manager License or certification(s) by the Mass Certification Unit with their bid.

expected.summary: Armed personnel needed a current Massachusetts Firearms License and training.
expected.evidence: Armed personnel must hold a current Massachusetts Firearms License and attend training

expected.summary: Bidders needed a pool of trained or cross-trained replacement guards for emergencies or extra coverage.
expected.evidence: Bidder’s must have a pool of trained and/or cross-trained replacement security guards or PI’s who can be called upon in an emergency situation or for extra coverage as needed.

expected.summary: Bidders had to list three to five business references; fewer than three valid-email references could cause disqualification.
expected.evidence: Bidders must list between three (3) and five (5) business references.

expected.summary: Attachment A had to identify covered counties or statewide coverage.
expected.evidence: Each Bidder must indicate on their Attachment A Bidder Response Form in their bid, the counties that their service will cover or alternatively if they will provide services to cover the entire State.

expected.summary: The active price workbook was Attachment B v2 dated April 8, 2022.
expected.evidence: Update to Attachment B

expected.summary: Attachment B pricing covered weekday/night/weekend, holiday, basic guard, wanding, armed, supervisor, and volume discount components.
expected.evidence: Hourly rates are inclusive ceiling rates. Use Attachment B Price Sheet Cost Table

expected.summary: Bidders had to submit Attachment E prompt-payment terms unless the requirement was waived for documented hardship.
expected.evidence: Bidders must submit agreeable terms on the Prompt Payment Discount Form (Attachment E), included on the Bid

expected.summary: Attachment D was required and the minimum acceptable SDP commitment was 1 percent.
expected.evidence: The minimum total SDP Commitment acceptable in responses to this solicitation shall be 1%.

expected.summary: At least 25 percent of the 100 evaluation points were allocated to SDP Plan submissions.
expected.evidence: at least 25% of the total available evaluation points (100) for this bid solicitation shall be allocated to the evaluation of the SDP Plan submissions

expected.summary: Quotes had to remain in effect for at least 90 days after submission.
expected.evidence: Bidders’ Quotes to this RFR must remain in effect for at least 90 days from the date of Quote submission.

expected.summary: Standard contract, terms, CASL, W-9, and EFT forms were post-award forms and were not to be submitted until requested.
expected.evidence: DO NOT SUBMIT THESE FORMS UNTIL INSTRUCTED TO DO SO.
